purpose: Vehicle-scoped, genuinely all-time driving and charging summary, personal records, environmental comparisons and achievements, with independently opt-in AI questions.
primaryGoal: Understand lifetime progress and savings, review records and achievement progress, and optionally ask source-grounded questions without changing workspace lifetime scope.

dataSources.behavior: analyticsKeys.lifetime(vehicleId); optional snake_case vehicle_id; AbortSignal forwarded; STALE_TIMES.SLOW retained. With no selected vehicle the query requests fleet totals rather than being disabled. SQL aggregates completed drives and charging sessions, with optional vehicle filtering and no date window.
dataSources.units: Actual existing response is km, km/h, hours, kWh, Wh/km and kg, not entirely canonical SI wire values. SQL reads SI columns and converts before responding. Current frontend restores meters, m/s, Wh and Wh/m for selected display adapters. Preserve existing math until coordinated contract migration; do not relabel payload units.
dataSources.sideEffects: The GET handler re-evaluates achievements with persistence and SSE broadcast (handler.go:492-507). It was NOT invoked by this audit.

dataSources.routeEvidence: Not independently traced to the vehicle route registration in this bounded audit.
dataSources.behavior: URL vehicle_id, stored selection and first vehicle determine selection; existing header picker owns scope. The lifetime page renders no duplicate picker.

issues.detail: Every locked achievement at >=80% progress receives unbounded animate-pulse independently of the page's motion-preference hook. Global CSS may suppress OS reduced-motion; this dependency does not itself honor the low-bandwidth motion preference. This is source evidence of decorative looping, not a measured accessibility failure.
issues.fix: Use static near-complete semantic emphasis; if temporary motion is retained, bound it and consume the existing useMotionPreference contract. Preserve the percentage and unlocked text.
issues.confidence: high for unconditional looping class; runtime reduction unverified

issues.detail: Once stats exists, missing individual personal records become 0 distance/speed/energy at lines 274,280,286. Missing savings fields similarly become measured zeros at lines 244-247. Source shells only check overall stats or gasoline cost, not individual availability. The current server normally supplies typed records; the fallback is a partial-payload trust risk, not proof that today's response is null.
issues.fix: Keep genuine zero values, but pass null/unknown individual measurements to existing display primitives and show localized unavailable values without removing panels. Retain record dates, units and comparisons.
issues.confidence: high for fallback behavior; runtime incidence unknown

issues.detail: Context status is Returned evidence whenever stats exists and error is null, including fetchStatus='paused'. LifetimeBrief.tsx:56-59 uses the same mapping. The page's deriveDataState detects paused retained data as stale, so neighboring summaries can disagree about trust. The six-hour freshness threshold is also only applied to metadata, not these source labels.
issues.fix: Pass existing DataState to each adapter; preserve retained data and distinguish paused/offline, refresh error and age-based freshness with localized status. Apply an agreed lifetime freshness threshold consistently without changing query policies.
issues.confidence: high from source branches; offline UI not exercised

issues.detail: The no-stats hero empty body says driven across 0 drives, despite having no source payload. The positive-empty case from the current backend is a populated aggregate object, so this custom fallback conflates absent evidence with an actual zero.
issues.fix: Keep the explanatory empty/retry body but omit or mark the unknown drive count until the source provides a measured zero.

architectureIssues.detail: Achievement timeout navigates to location.pathname, removing ALL query parameters and the hash rather than only achievement. A ?vehicle_id=... deep link loses explicit URL workspace identity after three seconds. The selected-vehicle store may retain the vehicle, but URL/bookmark state is still discarded.
architectureIssues.fix: Delete only achievement from a cloned URLSearchParams and replace while preserving other parameters and location.hash. Preserve the three-second cue, RAF cleanup and motion preference.

architectureIssues.detail: Lifetime wire type remains kilometer/hour/kWh-based, matching the existing backend response. The page correctly compensates for known km and km/h values rather than treating them as m/m/s. This is an existing integration contract gap; presentation-only work must not silently rename fields or remove conversions.
architectureIssues.fix: Schedule a separately owned coordinated API/types/backend contract migration with real-value parity tests. Until then preserve exact payloads, query keys and display-boundary conversions. Backend algorithms and achievement thresholds are out of this page writer's scope.

priority.reason: Fix source-confirmed achievement URL preservation first, then reconcile trust labels and missing values. Palette/motion adjustments are bounded follow-ons; SI wire correction requires a distinct integration owner, not page-only mutation.
